# Data Preparation and Cleaning
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#install.packages("NHANES")
#install.packages("car")
#install.packages("leaps")
library(leaps)
library(MASS)
library(NHANES)
library(car)
data(NHANES)
raw <- as.data.frame(NHANES)
cleaned <- subset(raw, select = c(BPSysAve,Gender,Age,BMI,AlcoholYear,PhysActiveDays))
cleaned <- cleaned[complete.cases(cleaned),]
```

# Model Fitting
```{r preliminary model, include=FALSE}
og_model <- lm(BPSysAve ~ Gender + Age + BMI + AlcoholYear + PhysActiveDays, data=cleaned)
```
# Multicollinearity: VIF
```{r}
# No severe multicollinearity
vif(og_model)
```
# Check Conditions
```{r}
y_value <- resid(og_model)
x_value <- fitted(og_model)

#Condition 1
plot(x=x_value, y=cleaned$BPSysAve, xlab="Fitted", ylab="Response", main="Systolic Blood Pressure vs. Fitted")

#Condition 2
pairs(cleaned[,2:6])
```

# Check Assumptions
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(x=cleaned$Gender, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. Gender", xlab="Gender", ylab="Residual")
plot(x=cleaned$Age, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. Age", xlab = "Age", ylab="Residual")
plot(x=cleaned$BMI, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. BMI", xlab = "BMI", ylab="Residual")
plot(x=cleaned$AlcoholYear, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. AlcoholYear", xlab = "AlcoholYear", ylab="Residual")
plot(x=cleaned$PhysActiveDays, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. PhysActiveDays", xlab = "PhysActiveDays", ylab="Residual")

plot(x=x_value, y=y_value, main="Residual vs. Fitted Values", xlab="Fitted", ylab="Residuals")

qqnorm(resid(og_model))
qqline(resid(og_model))
```

# Step 1: Transformation
## Linearity and Normality: Box-Cox Transformation
```{r box-cox}
library(car)
# try box-cox on response
boxCox(og_model) # p close to -1, so do an inverse transformation on Y
cleaned$invBPSysAve <- 1/cleaned$BPSysAve

# try box-cox on predictors
shifted_data <- cbind(cleaned[,3:4], cleaned$AlcoholYear + 1, cleaned$PhysActiveDays) # shift AlcoholYear to positive for box-cox transformation: all entries must be positive
p <- powerTransform(shifted_data) # omitted Gender because it's categorical
# summary(p)

# transform predictors by the following power transformations:
# Age: p = 0.4253758 
cleaned$transAge <- sqrt(cleaned$Age)
# BMI: p = -0.5791088
cleaned$transBMI <- 1/sqrt(cleaned$BMI)
# AlcoholYear: p = 0.1194823
cleaned$transAlcoholYear <- log(cleaned$AlcoholYear + 1)
# PhysActiveDays: p = 0.4983646 
cleaned$transPhysActiveDays <- sqrt(cleaned$PhysActiveDays)
# Gender: NONE

# refit model
trans_model_bc <- lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear + transPhysActiveDays, data=cleaned)
e_hat <- resid(trans_model_bc)
y_hat <- fitted(trans_model_bc)

#summary(trans_model_bc)
```
## Multicollinearity: VIF
```{r}
vif(trans_model_bc)
```
## Condition 1 & Assumptions 
```{r}
# display result
plot(x=y_hat, y=cleaned$invBPSysAve, xlab="Fitted", ylab="Response", main="Inverse of Systolic Blood Pressure vs. Fitted")
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(y_hat, e_hat, xlab="Fitted Values", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e_hat ~ cleaned$transAge, xlab="sqrt(Age)", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e_hat ~ cleaned$transBMI, xlab="1/sqrt(BMI)", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e_hat ~ cleaned$transAlcoholYear, xlab="log(AlcoholYear + 1)", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e_hat ~ cleaned$transPhysActiveDays, xlab="sqrt(PhysActiveDays)", ylab="Residuals")
qqnorm(e_hat); qqline(e_hat)
```
## Condition 2 Revisited
Notice the strong parabolic relationship between BMI and AlcoholYear are corrected.
```{r condition 2}
pairs(cbind(cleaned[,2], cleaned[,8:11]))
```

# Step 2: Significance tests
## ANOVA Overall Significance Test
```{r}
# display the full model summary of trans_model_1
summary(trans_model_1)

# significance level
alpha <- 0.05 

# p-value for the ANOVA test
pvalue_anova <- 2.2e-16
```

## T-test
```{r}
model_summary1 <- summary(trans_model_1)

# extract p-values for each predictor's t-test
t_test_p_values1 <- model_summary1$coefficients[, 4]

# display the p-values for each predictor
cat("P-values for individual predictors:\n")
print(t_test_p_values1)


# identify which predictors have p-values greater than alpha
insignificant_predictors1 <- names(t_test_p_values1)[t_test_p_values1 > alpha]
```

## Partial F Test
```{r}
# fit model that removes transPhysActiveDays
reduced_model1 <- lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear, data = cleaned)

# conduct partial F test
anova(reduced_model1, trans_model_1)

# F statistic
F_value <- 0.2258
```

# Step 3: Model Selection
## All Possible Subsets
```{r}
best1 <- regsubsets(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear + transPhysActiveDays, data = cleaned, nvmax = 5)
summary(best1)
subsets(best1, statistic="adjr2", legend=FALSE)
```
## Automated Selection: Forward
```{r}
stepAIC(lm(invBPSysAve ~ 1, data = cleaned),
  scope = list(upper = lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear + transPhysActiveDays, data = cleaned)), 
  direction = "forward", k = 2)
```
## Automated Selection: Backward
```{r}
stepAIC(lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear + transPhysActiveDays, data = cleaned),
  scope = list(lower = lm(invBPSysAve ~ 1, data = cleaned)), 
  direction = "backward", k=2)
```
## Automated Selection: Step Wise
```{r}
stepAIC(lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear + transPhysActiveDays, data = cleaned),
  direction = "both", k=2)
```
# Step 4: Final Model (without interaction)
## Check Assumptions of Final Model
```{r}
wo_interaction_model <- lm(invBPSysAve ~ Gender + transAge + transBMI + transAlcoholYear, data = cleaned)
e1_hat <- resid(wo_interaction_model)
y1_hat <- fitted(wo_interaction_model)


plot(x=y1_hat, y=cleaned$invBPSysAve, xlab="Fitted", ylab="Response", main="Inverse of Systolic Blood Pressure vs. Fitted")
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(y1_hat, e1_hat, xlab="Fitted Values", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e1_hat ~ cleaned$transAge, xlab="sqrt(Age)", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e1_hat ~ cleaned$transBMI, xlab="1/sqrt(BMI)", ylab="Residuals")
plot(e1_hat ~ cleaned$transAlcoholYear, xlab="log(AlcoholYear + 1)", ylab="Residuals")
qqnorm(e1_hat); qqline(e1_hat)
```

## Problematic observations
### Leverage points
```{r}
p <- 4
n <- 2913

hii <- hatvalues(wo_interaction_model)
cutoff_hii <- 2*(p+1/n)
leverages <- which(hii>cutoff_hii)
paste0("Number of leverages: ", length(leverages))
```

### Outliers
```{r}
ri <- rstandard(wo_interaction_model)
outliers <- which(ri < -4 | 4 < ri)
paste0("Number of outliers: ", length(outliers))
```
### Influential on all fitted values
```{r}
di <- cooks.distance(wo_interaction_model)
cutoff_di <- qf(0.5, p+1, n-p-1)
influential_all_fitted <- which(di > cutoff_di)
paste0("Number of influential points on all fitted values: ", length(influential_all_fitted))
```
### Influential on own fitted values
```{r}
dffits <- dffits(wo_interaction_model)
cutoff_dffits <- 2*sqrt(p+1/n)
influential_own_fitted <- which(abs(dffits) > cutoff_dffits)
paste0("Number of influential points on own fitted values: ", length(influential_own_fitted))
```
### Influential on all coefficients
```{r}
dfbetas <- dfbetas(wo_interaction_model)
cutoff_dbetas <- 2/sqrt(n)
# which observations are influential by dfbetas?
influentials_beta0 <- which(abs(dfbetas[,1]) > cutoff_dbetas)
influentials_beta1 <- which(abs(dfbetas[,2]) > cutoff_dbetas)
influentials_beta2 <- which(abs(dfbetas[,3]) > cutoff_dbetas)
influentials_beta3 <- which(abs(dfbetas[,4]) > cutoff_dbetas)
influentials_beta4 <- which(abs(dfbetas[,5]) > cutoff_dbetas)
paste0("Number of influential points on beta0: ", length(influentials_beta0))
paste0("Number of influential points on beta1: ", length(influentials_beta1))
paste0("Number of influential points on beta2: ", length(influentials_beta2))
paste0("Number of influential points on beta3: ", length(influentials_beta3))
paste0("Number of influential points on beta4: ", length(influentials_beta4))
```
Influential points on all fitted values, its own fitted values, and coefficients:
```{r}
all_influential <- Reduce(intersect, list(influential_all_fitted,influential_own_fitted,  influentials_beta0, influentials_beta1, influentials_beta2, influentials_beta3, influentials_beta4))
paste0("The number of points that are influential in all 3 ways discussed: ", length(all_influential))
```
### Problematic observation: summary
```{r}
outliers
leverages
influential_all_fitted
influential_own_fitted
Reduce(intersect, list(influentials_beta0, influentials_beta1, 
                       influentials_beta2, influentials_beta3,
                       influentials_beta4)) # influential on all coefficients
```
Notice observation #2340 and #2371 are both outliers and influential on all predictor coeffcients. Let's see their values.

```{r}
cleaned[2340,]
cleaned[2371,] # BPSysAve looks clearly wrong, but we don't have the context to remove
```
